column1: # THE SAME table as the esp_hosted examples for 4MB with dual OTA.
# Flashing over the cable (idf.py flash / gravar.sh) writes THIS table to the C6
# together with the bootloader and otadata: it is the one in force on the device. (An OTA would
# not rewrite the table - only the image in the free slot.)
# IT ONLY CHANGES OVER THE CABLE. That is why it is born with what a future OTA may
#   - 1.875 MB slots (the image is ~1.4 MB: ~25% headroom to grow);
#   - coredump: the C6 writes the snapshot of a crash here
